2016.change_reason: First available year, so there is no prior to compare against.
2016.analyst_notes: Mission-led copy ('alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life') with a founder story ('put people first') and a corporate-responsibility pointer. Figures are few (85,000 employees, 260 locations, 155 countries), and much of the text is browser-warning and navigation boilerplate.

2017.change_reason: The copy matches 2016 with layout and navigation relabeling, and the figures (85,000 employees, 260 locations, 155 countries) are unchanged.
2017.analyst_notes: Substance is unchanged. The page is a navigation shell around a short mission statement and a CEO quote, and the 'deep sense of moral purpose' line is the only explicit values language.

2018.change_reason: Only headline figures change (about 84,000 employees, 370 locations in about 160 countries), while the mission and responsibility copy is unchanged.
2018.analyst_notes: Footprint language grows, but the values language is unchanged from 2017.

2019.change_reason: The captured text collapses to a single corporate governance blurb, dropping the mission, workforce and location copy present in 2018, which looks like a capture or layout artifact rather than a deliberate content change.
2019.analyst_notes: Only a governance line is captured, so this year cannot be judged on its own. The 2020 page is a full redesign, which suggests the 2019 snapshot was partial, so treat this change flag with caution.

2020.change_reason: The page is rebuilt as 'Who We Are' with new copy on diverse perspectives, accountability, quality and reducing environmental impact, plus Careers, Citizenship and COVID-19 sections.
2020.analyst_notes: Adds explicit people and environment language ('we value diverse perspectives'; 'reducing our impact on the environment') and a quantified reach (about 75 million people treated a year, 70 conditions). The citizenship language is brief.

2021.change_reason: An 'Inclusion, Diversity, and Equity Report' link and an 'ESG Performance and Progress' section are added and the COVID-19 block is dropped, while the who-we-are copy stays nearly identical (patients treated figure falls from 75M to 72M).
2021.analyst_notes: Dedicated DEI and ESG reporting links make the commitments more visible, but the page points to reports rather than stating targets. The patient-reach figure drops from 75M to 72M without explanation on the page.

2022.analyst_notes: Copy is word-for-word the same as 2021, so the DEI and ESG report links carry forward without new wording.
